name: argocd
title: ArgoCD
description: Search applications across several ArgoCD instances, then open, inspect or sync them.
author: pixibixi

commands.name: search-applications
commands.title: Search Applications
commands.subtitle: ArgoCD
commands.description: Search ArgoCD applications across every configured instance.

commands.name: search-applicationsets
commands.title: Search ApplicationSets
commands.subtitle: ArgoCD
commands.description: Search ApplicationSets and jump to the applications they generated.

commands.name: manage-instances
commands.title: Manage Instances
commands.subtitle: ArgoCD
commands.description: Add, edit and remove the ArgoCD instances the extension queries.

commands.name: monitor
commands.title: Monitor
commands.subtitle: ArgoCD
commands.description: Menu bar counter of the degraded and out-of-sync applications across every instance. Also keeps the local cache warm, so the search command stays instant.

preferences.name: showWhenHealthy
preferences.title: When everything is healthy
preferences.label: Show the application count
preferences.description: Off by default, so the menu bar stays quiet until something needs attention.

preferences.name: cacheTtlSeconds
preferences.title: Cache TTL
preferences.description: Seconds before a cached application list is refreshed in the background. Clamped to 5-3600.

preferences.name: requestTimeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Request Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds before an ArgoCD API request is aborted. Clamped to 3-120.

preferences.name: probeTimeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Reachability Probe Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds before an instance is considered unreachable. Kept short so a VPN that is down is reported immediately. Clamped to 1-30.

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of applications rendered at once. Clamped to 10-200.

preferences.name: argocdCliPath
preferences.title: argocd CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the argocd binary used for the SSO login action.
